newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech CNB-120 index falls 0.5 points to 738.7 pts.
newsitem.headline: Czech CNB-120 index falls 0.5 points to 738.7 pts.

text.p: The CNB-120 index, a broad daily measure of Czech equities, lost 0.5 points on Tuesday to 738.7 points, the Czech National Bank (CNB) said.
Four of the 10 sectoral indices lost, with the investment funds index losing the most, down 25.5 points to 1,127.6.
Six indices rose, with the construction index rising the most, up 17.6 points to 916.
